## Step 1 · The Dataset {background-color="#000000"}

```{=html}
<div style="text-align:center;">
  <div class="stat-card"><span class="val">1,440</span><span class="lbl">rows</span></div>
  <div class="stat-card"><span class="val">24</span><span class="lbl">hotels</span></div>
  <div class="stat-card"><span class="val">6</span><span class="lbl">room types</span></div>
  <div class="stat-card"><span class="val">10</span><span class="lbl">sample dates each</span></div>
</div>
<div style="margin-top:1.8em; text-align:center; max-width:850px; margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto;">
  Published rate-card data, not scraped. Two targets from one column: <strong class="gold-l">is_premium</strong> (> €3,000/night) for classification, <strong class="gold-l">nightly rate</strong> for regression.
</div>
```

---

## Step 2 · EDA & Cleaning {background-color="#000000"}

```{=html}
<div class="two-col">
<div>
  <div class="box">
    <div class="box-title">Skew → Log Transform</div>
    <div class="box-body"><ul style="margin:0; padding-left:1.1em;">
      <li>Raw nightly rate: heavily right-skewed</li>
      <li>Log transform → near-normal</li>
      <li>Cleaner regression residuals + classifier boundary</li>
    </ul></div>
  </div>
  <div class="box">
    <div class="box-title">Row-Level Checks — All Clean</div>
    <div class="box-body"><ul style="margin:0; padding-left:1.1em;">
      <li>No duplicates, no invalid rates</li>
      <li>No inconsistent category spelling</li>
      <li>Hand-assembled data, not scraped</li>
    </ul></div>
  </div>
</div>
<div>
  <div class="box" style="border-color:rgba(232,84,74,0.4);">
    <div class="box-title" style="color:#E8544A;">2 Outlier Hotels Removed</div>
    <div class="box-body"><ul style="margin:0; padding-left:1.1em;">
      <li>IQR fence on hotel-level median rate</li>
      <li><strong class="gold-l">Cheval Blanc Randheli</strong> + <strong class="gold-l">The Brando</strong> — 2–3× portfolio</li>
      <li>Left in → model memorises 2 brands, not pricing logic</li>
      <li>26 → 24 hotels</li>
    </ul></div>
  </div>
</div>
</div>
```

---

## Step 3 · Feature Engineering + Selection {background-color="#000000"}

```{=html}
<div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:1.2em;">
  <span class="tag">Type of Room</span>
  <span class="tag">How Exclusive Is the Hotel?</span>
  <span class="tag">Which Month? (×2 waves)</span>
  <span class="tag">How Close to Christmas?</span>
  <span class="tag">School Holiday?</span>
  <span class="tag">Resort Type</span>
</div>
<div class="box" style="border-color:rgba(232,84,74,0.4); max-width:950px; margin:0 auto;">
  <div class="box-title" style="color:#E8544A;">The Finding That Drove This Redesign</div>
  <div class="box-body"><ul style="margin:0; padding-left:1.1em;">
    <li>Raw month × raw days-to-Christmas: <strong class="gold-l">r = −0.998</strong> — near-duplicates</li>
    <li>Fix: nonlinear Christmas-proximity curve + cyclic month encoding → r = 0.503</li>
    <li><strong>Selection method:</strong> correlation filter + VIF audit</li>
    <li>Every surviving feature under VIF=10, each with a clear business meaning</li>
  </ul></div>
</div>
```

---

## Step 4 · Leakage-Safe Split {background-color="#000000"}

```{=html}
<div style="text-align:center;">
  <div class="stat-card"><span class="val">80/20</span><span class="lbl">stratified split</span></div>
  <div class="stat-card"><span class="val">5-fold</span><span class="lbl">cross-validation</span></div>
  <div class="stat-card"><span class="val">288</span><span class="lbl">test rows, untouched</span></div>
</div>
<div style="margin-top:1.8em; text-align:center; max-width:850px; margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto;">
  <ul style="display:inline-block; text-align:left; margin:0; padding-left:1.1em;">
    <li>Split happens <strong class="gold-l">first</strong>, before any fitting</li>
    <li>Scaling + encoding inside one <strong class="gold-l">scikit-learn Pipeline</strong></li>
    <li>Fit on training data only — test set invisible until the final score</li>
  </ul>
</div>
```

## Step 5 · Model Ladder — Classification {background-color="#000000"}

```{=html}
<div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:0.8em; font-size:0.85em; color:#666;">Dummy → Logistic → Decision Tree → Random Forest → GradBoost → <strong class="gold-l">XGBoost</strong></div>
<div style="text-align:center;">
  <div class="stat-card"><span class="val">0.805</span><span class="lbl">Test F1-macro (XGBoost)</span></div>
  <div class="stat-card"><span class="val">0.356</span><span class="lbl">Dummy baseline F1</span></div>
  <div class="stat-card"><span class="val">0.905</span><span class="lbl">ROC-AUC</span></div>
</div>
<div style="margin-top:1em; text-align:center; font-size:0.85em; color:#888;">
  Tuned via real <strong class="gold-l">GridSearchCV</strong>, cross-validated · more than double the Dummy baseline
</div>
```

---

## Step 5 · Model Ladder — Regression {background-color="#000000"}

```{=html}
<div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:0.8em; font-size:0.85em; color:#666;">Dummy → Ridge → Decision Tree → Random Forest → <strong class="gold-l">GradBoost</strong> → XGBoost</div>
<div style="text-align:center;">
  <div class="stat-card"><span class="val">0.736</span><span class="lbl">Test R² (GradBoost)</span></div>
  <div class="stat-card"><span class="val">€1,677</span><span class="lbl">MAE / night</span></div>
  <div class="stat-card"><span class="val">€3,321</span><span class="lbl">Dummy MAE</span></div>
</div>
<div style="margin-top:1em; text-align:center; font-size:0.85em; color:#888;">
  Half the Dummy error · 0% → <strong class="gold-l">73.6%</strong> of rate variance explained
</div>
```

---

## Step 6 · Benchmark & Honest Evaluation {background-color="#000000"}

```{=html}
<div class="two-col">
<div>
  <div class="box" style="border-color:rgba(232,84,74,0.4);">
    <div class="box-title" style="color:#E8544A;">Where Overfitting First Showed Up</div>
    <div class="box-body"><ul style="margin:0; padding-left:1.1em;">
      <li>Full-depth Decision Tree: Train F1=1.000, Test F1=0.719</li>
      <li>Memorised training rows, not a real pattern</li>
      <li>Depth-capped GradBoost/XGBoost: gap 0.14–0.39 → <strong class="gold-l">0.06–0.07</strong></li>
    </ul></div>
  </div>
</div>
<div>
  <div class="box">
    <div class="box-title">Right Metric for This Data</div>
    <div class="box-body"><ul style="margin:0; padding-left:1.1em;">
      <li>Classes imbalanced (35/65) → <strong class="gold-l">F1-macro</strong>, not accuracy</li>
      <li>Rates have expensive outliers → <strong class="gold-l">MAE</strong>, not just R²</li>
    </ul></div>
  </div>
</div>
</div>
<div style="margin-top:0.6em; text-align:center; font-size:0.85em; color:#888;">
  Dummy stays in every leaderboard · every number here is <strong class="gold-l">test-set</strong>, never train
</div>
```

---

## What Do These Numbers Actually Mean? {background-color="#000000"}

```{=html}
<div class="two-col">
<div>
  <div class="box">
    <div class="box-title">Classification — F1-macro = 0.805</div>
    <div class="box-body"><ul style="margin:0; padding-left:1.1em;">
      <li>Accuracy alone is misleading: guessing "Standard" every time already scores 66%</li>
      <li>F1-macro forces the model to prove itself on <strong class="gold-l">both</strong> Premium and Standard, not just the easy majority</li>
      <li>0.805 = the model is genuinely good at telling the two apart, not riding a shortcut</li>
    </ul></div>
  </div>
  <div class="box">
    <div class="box-title">ROC-AUC = 0.905</div>
    <div class="box-body"><ul style="margin:0; padding-left:1.1em;">
      <li>Plain-English: pick a random Premium booking and a random Standard one</li>
      <li>The model ranks the Premium one higher <strong class="gold-l">90.5%</strong> of the time</li>
    </ul></div>
  </div>
</div>
<div>
  <div class="box">
    <div class="box-title">Regression — MAE = €1,677</div>
    <div class="box-body"><ul style="margin:0; padding-left:1.1em;">
      <li>Same units as the price itself — the most honest "how wrong is it, in euros" number</li>
      <li>Estimate €3,500? Real price is usually within about €1,677 either side</li>
      <li>Chosen over RMSE because a few very expensive suites don't distort it as much</li>
    </ul></div>
  </div>
  <div class="box">
    <div class="box-title">R² = 0.736</div>
    <div class="box-body"><ul style="margin:0; padding-left:1.1em;">
      <li>73.6% of why prices differ is explained by hotel, month, and room alone</li>
      <li>The rest: real-world randomness — promotions, last-minute deals, demand spikes we don't have data on</li>
    </ul></div>
  </div>
</div>
</div>
```
